lines.text: Many learners say: In my city is a park.
Better: In my city, there is a park.
Use there is to say it exists.
There is! In my room, there is a bed.

data.wrong: In my city is a park.
data.right: In my city, there is a park.
data.why: Use there is to say it exists.

native.tip: نقول بالعربية «في مدينتي حديقة» بلا كلمة مثل there، لكن الإنجليزية تحتاجها: “In my city, there is a park.” وليس “In my city is a park.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “In my city is a park.” 😅 نقول there is للدلالة على الوجود ولا نكتفي بـ is وحدها، فالجملة الصحيحة “In my city, there is a park.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “There is” — نقول there is للدلالة على الوجود ولا نكتفي بـ is وحدها. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.tip: To say something exists we use there is: “In my city, there is a park.” not “In my city is a park.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “In my city is a park.” 😅 In English we say there is to show that something exists, so the right sentence is “In my city, there is a park.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
